reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 19 points better, in a game of about 239 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 94 times in 100, by about 19; most games like this end between 214 and 262 total points.
